resources.string: Your chats
WhatsApp chat history and its backups.
KeepClear never deletes these.
Already deleted in other apps
You already deleted these in another app. They\'re waiting in that app\'s recycle bin.
They\'re gone for good after KeepClear\'s 30-day trash. You already chose to delete them once.
Viewed WhatsApp statuses
Statuses you already watched. They expire after 24 hours anyway.
Nothing changes in WhatsApp. Old statuses can\'t be watched again either way.
Recent WhatsApp statuses
Statuses from the last day. WhatsApp removes them soon.
You won\'t be able to watch them again.
Old WhatsApp folder
WhatsApp used this folder before 2022. The app now keeps its files somewhere else.
Photos and videos only here would be gone. Your current chats are not affected.
Copies of photos you sent
WhatsApp keeps a copy of every photo you send. These are byte-for-byte copies of photos still in your gallery.
The originals stay in your gallery. Inside the chat, these images may no longer open.
Things you sent on WhatsApp
Copies of media you sent. We couldn\'t find the original on this phone.
If this is the only copy, it will be gone. The message stays in the chat.
Hidden WhatsApp media
Media you chose to hide from the gallery.
If this is the only copy, it will be gone.
Photos and videos people sent you
Memories from your chats. These are often the only copy.
KeepClear only removes them after copying them to your drive and checking every file.
Other WhatsApp files
Documents, stickers, audio and other files from your chats.
Files that exist only here would be gone. Chats stay.
Thumbnails
Small preview images that apps create.
Apps create them again when needed.
Recovered fragments
Pieces of files Android recovered after a storage error.
These are rarely usable. Look first if you lost something recently.
Temporary files
Files apps left behind while saving or uploading.
Nothing you use should change.
Computer leftovers
Hidden files that Windows or Mac create when the phone is connected.
Nothing changes on the phone.
Already-unpacked archives
The folder next to each archive already has all of its files.
The unpacked files stay. Only the archive goes.
Partly unpacked archives
Only some of the files inside are next to it.
Files not unpacked would be gone.
Screenshots
Screenshots are often temporary: a code, a map, a receipt. Some might matter.
They\'re gone from the phone. Take a quick look first.
AI images
Images made with ChatGPT and similar apps.
You can usually find them again in that app\'s history.
Call recordings
Recordings of phone calls. They may contain conversations you want to keep.
Recordings that exist only here would be gone.
Left from your old phone
Folders created by apps from a previous phone (MIUI, ShareMe).
Look inside first: they may hold photos that exist nowhere else.
Photos and videos saved from Telegram
Media you saved from Telegram chats.
KeepClear only removes them after a checked backup.
Files saved from Telegram
Documents and music you saved from Telegram.
You can usually download them again from the chat.
Old Telegram folder
Telegram used this folder on older versions.
Media that exists only here would be gone.
Camera photos and videos
Your photos and videos, and the biggest space saver.
KeepClear only removes them after copying them to your drive and checking every file.
Large videos
Videos over 100 MB.
If this is the only copy, it will be gone. Consider moving it to a drive instead.
App installers
Installer files (APK) for apps.
Apps already installed keep working.
Old downloads
Files you downloaded more than 3 months ago.
Files that exist only here would be gone.
Other files
We don\'t know what these are. Here\'s what\'s inside.
Files that exist only here would be gone. Look first.
Photos and videos in your albums
Photos and videos saved in your Pictures folders.
KeepClear only removes them after copying them to your drive and checking every file.
